info.title: Reme contracts
info.description: Every payload that crosses a team boundary. Generated from the Zod schemas in packages/contracts; edit those, not this file.

change_kind.description: How big the change is. copy: words only, such as a headline, a phone number or a button label. style: colours, fonts or spacing across the site. section: add, remove or rework one section or page. photo: replace, add or remove a picture. creative: a new look, new pages or anything unclear. Omit it when unsure.
